task.title: A topic fails the structure check
task.shortdesc: A count of headings, tables, rows, list items, code blocks or images differs between the two pages.

context.p: Cause: An element converted to a different structure, for example a table that became a list.

step.cmd: Read which count differs and by how much.
Find the element in the source that produces that structure.
Approve or write a mapping rule that rewrites it into DITA the converter handles.
